description: BugHappens is a student team building software to monitor astronaut health during space missions. The idea: collect vital signs from wearable sensors (heart rate, blood oxygen, sleep, stress), use machine learning to flag early warning signs, and keep this sensitive medical data private and secure. We bring electronics, ML and data protection skills. Looking for: a frontend or mobile developer, someone with medical or biology knowledge, and a pitch designer. Bugs happen; we fix them fast.
